manufacturer.name: Dominator
manufacturer.note: New Zealand garage door and opener manufacturer. Serves its documents from a flat /asset/ path under bare numeric IDs - 3133.pdf, 4025.pdf, 4026.pdf all surfaced. Only 3133 came back with a title, so it is the only one recorded; 4025 and 4026 are real Dominator PDFs whose contents are unidentified from search alone, and creating models for them would mean inventing what they cover. The asset path is registered as a harvest target so they can be resolved properly rather than guessed at now.
